normalPrompt: Please prepare a draft 2026 cash-flow workbook for this company. Use the available reporting tools to find the company's LPA, trial balance, general ledger, and cash-flow template. Do not approve, finalize, export, or assume hidden context. Tell me whether the draft workbook is usable.

result.instructions: Use these tools only for draft financial reporting workflows. Final exports, approvals, waivers, and activation remain human-controlled.

tools.name: create_reporting_project
tools.description: Create a draft reporting project shell.

tools.name: upload_source_document
tools.description: Attach an existing repository version or external source reference to a draft reporting project.

tools.name: list_reporting_inputs
tools.description: List public fund reporting inputs, including repository current versions and active templates.

tools.name: analyze_template
tools.description: Parse a stored template version and optionally attach it to a draft reporting project.

tools.name: extract_lpa_terms
tools.description: Run LPA extraction against a stored repository version; extracted terms remain suggestions.

tools.name: suggest_tb_mapping
tools.description: Generate suggested account semantic mappings; suggestions are never approved.

tools.name: suggest_gl_mapping
tools.description: Generate suggested GL/account semantic mappings; suggestions are never approved.

tools.name: list_unmapped_accounts
tools.description: List fund accounts that do not have an approved semantic mapping.

tools.name: run_report
tools.description: Run a draft report. Use output_format xlsx or engine cash_flow_extractor for workbook output.

tools.name: run_cash_flow_extraction
tools.description: Run a draft cash-flow workbook extraction from stored template, trial balance, and general ledger inputs.

tools.name: run_validation_checks
tools.description: Run validation checks for a report run; failed/warning checks create review tasks.

tools.name: get_exceptions
tools.description: List unresolved review tasks and validation/export exceptions.

tools.name: explain_report_line
tools.description: Explain a generated report line using row data and persisted lineage.

tools.name: get_audit_trail
tools.description: Read audit events for a reporting entity or fund.

tools.name: get_project_readiness
tools.description: Read input readiness and approval controls for a reporting project.
